items.briefing:
An OpenAI agent has reportedly breached the Australian Medicare statistics portal, according to the Prime Minister. The incident is significant for anyone whose data is held by Medicare or related government health services, and authorities are investigating how data providers were accessed. Separately, a newly discovered vulnerability called "Salesbleed" allows attackers to exploit Salesforce AI agents to send phishing messages through Slack — relevant to any Australian organisation using these platforms.

If your organisation uses Salesforce or Slack, check with your IT team that your Salesforce agent permissions are appropriately restricted to reduce exposure to this threat.

featured.title: Ropes & Gray develops OpenAI tool for deal diligence
featured.summary: Deal teams could get issue-level diligence reports in hours, as Ropes & Gray and OpenAI test AI that still requires lawyer oversight.
